categories.confidentialSafeDesc: These processors keep your data local and safe. Your documents are not sent to external AI services.
categories.hybridsDesc: Combine multiple OCR engines with AI for enhanced accuracy. Data goes to configured API services.
categories.experimentalDesc: Cutting-edge processors for specialized use cases. Some may have limited availability.

processors.name: Google Cloud Vision
processors.description: Fast, reliable paragraph-level OCR with high accuracy
processors.bestFor: General PDF documents, scanned images, documents with clear text

processors.name: Azure Read API
processors.description: Cost-effective word-level OCR with good accuracy
processors.bestFor: Cost-sensitive projects, mixed document types, handwritten content

processors.name: Azure Layout API
processors.bestFor: Documents with tables, complex layouts, structured forms

processors.name: Document AI
processors.description: Advanced word-level OCR with structure analysis
processors.bestFor: Complex documents, specialized document types, entity extraction needs

processors.name: Cloud Vision + Gemini Hybrid
processors.cost: ~0.15-0.30 yen per image (depends on low-confidence region count)
processors.bestFor: Complex documents, mixed quality images, maximum accuracy requirements

processors.name: Azure Read + Gemini Hybrid
processors.cost: ~0.225-0.40 yen per image (depends on low-confidence word count)
features: Good balance of cost and accuracy
processors.bestFor: Budget-conscious projects, good accuracy needs, general documents

processors.name: Document AI + Gemini Hybrid
processors.description: Advanced hybrid with Document AI validation workflow
processors.cost: ~0.25-0.50 yen per image (depends on validation issues)
processors.bestFor: Complex documents, validation-critical workflows, entity extraction

processors.name: Gemini Self-Calibrating
processors.description: AI-powered coordinate calibration using Cloud Vision as reference
processors.cost: ~0.25-0.40 yen per image (depends on Gemini-only text count)
processors.bestFor: Documents requiring precise coordinate extraction, floor plans, technical drawings

processors.name: Gemini Coordinates
processors.description: Asks Gemini for text + percentage coordinates (EXPERIMENTAL)
processors.bestFor: Coordinate extraction, experimental workflows, budget-limited testing

processors.name: Gemini Bbox Synthesis
processors.description: Matches Gemini text to Cloud Vision bboxes (EXPERIMENTAL)
processors.bestFor: Bounding box extraction, experimental coordinate workflows

processors.name: Gemini Validation - Azure Read
processors.description: Uses Gemini as QA reviewer to validate Azure Read results (EXPERIMENTAL)
processors.cost: ~0.30-0.50 yen per image (depends on issues found)
processors.bestFor: Quality-critical workflows, validation scenarios, error detection

processors.name: Region Classifier
processors.description: Smart routing: Azure for high confidence, Gemini for low (EXPERIMENTAL)
processors.cost: ~1.50-1.70 yen per image (depends on low-confidence region count)
processors.bestFor: Mixed quality documents, adaptive processing, cost optimization

processors.name: Gemini Geometric
processors.description: AI-powered floor plan analysis with wall and room detection
processors.bestFor: Floor plan analysis, architectural documents, spatial understanding
processors.note: Experimental - specialized for floor plans and architectural documents
